notesI18n.zh:
· 新增 Clootee 默认服务商：一键开始，自动领取设备额度，顶部显示余额，每轮显示花费
· 设置里可直接选择 Claude / OpenAI 官方 API（填 Key 按量计费），OpenRouter 提前
· 使用 Claude 官方 API 时，每轮回复按官方价目精确计价（含缓存读写），可展开明细，会话列表显示累计花费
· Windows 后台隐藏运行，流式事件性能优化
notesI18n.en:
· New Clootee default provider: one-click start, free device credit, balance badge and per-turn cost
· Pick the official Claude / OpenAI API (pay-as-you-go key) directly in settings; OpenRouter moved up
· With the official Claude API, every turn shows an exact cost at official prices (including cache reads/writes) with an expandable breakdown, plus per-session totals
· The hub runs hidden in the background on Windows; faster stream event handling
